record.title: Policy on the Responsible and Ethical Use of Artificial Intelligence in Nevada State Government Executive Branch (draft)

title.quote: Policy on the Responsible and Ethical Use of Artificial Intelligence in Nevada State Government Executive Branch
All state agencies must comply with this policy and related standards as a minimum requirement but are encouraged to develop more stringent policies and standards

judgment.scope_reasoning: Same instrument as C038, not a 2026 update. The stored draft has the same title and, apart from page footers, the same text as the signed policy stored for C038 (a word-level comparison of the two text layers differs only in footers, scan errors and the signature block); it lacks the signature block and the 'Effective Date : November 26, 2024' line, and the server dates the file 4 Sep 2024. It is the unsigned draft of the policy that C038 records, so it adds nothing to that record beyond a remark in its verification note.

open_questions: target_id C038 is a candidate of this run, not an existing record: the draft is covered by the record that C038 will become.
